verdict: Real cash-and-stock merger (AMEC); library published only the $32 all-cash election and no last trade date.

verification.notes: The 8-K of 2014-11-13 (0001144204-14-067433) sets the Offer Consideration at $16.00 cash plus 0.8998 Amec Foster Wheeler securities per share. The $32.00 cash and the 1.7996 securities are only elections, subject to proration. The library's published cash 32.00 is therefore the election, not the default package. The Form 25 (0001144204-14-070496) is a voluntary 12d2-2(c) filing and no filing states a last trade date. Not confirmed: the AMFW ticker (it rests on web only), the $1.6B aggregate-cash detail (my search of the 8-K did not find it), and the realised package after proration (the 8-K does not state it).
